name: Navigation
summary: Moves between the pages of an app or a document set: headed groups of pages and families of pages, the current page marked. Groups are told apart by a heading and the largest space; a family's pages sit under its name, indented so their names line up with it, and open and close together. A family inside a family indents one more step (three at most). Not for actions (use Button), for choosing how content shows (use SegmentedControl) or for the steps of a task.
a11y: Put it inside a navigation landmark (LibraryLayout's nav region is one). Each group's title is a heading and names its list; each family is a disclosure button (`aria-expanded`, `aria-controls`) over its own list. The current item carries `aria-current="page"` and keeps an outline in forced colours, so it is never shown by colour alone. Items and family buttons keep a 44 px target, a gap between them so two fills never touch, the same geometry on hover, press and focus, and room for an unclipped focus ring. Collapsed, it is one native disclosure whose summary names the current page.

keys.action: moves through the items and family buttons in reading order
opens or closes the focused family, or the collapsed disclosure from its summary

props.name: current
props.description: The `id` of the page the person is on: marked with a full-shape fill and `aria-current`.

props.name: expanded
props.description: The `id`s of the open families. Leave it out and the navigation keeps its own, starting with the current page's family open.

props.name: onExpandedChange
props.description: Called with the open families' `id`s when the person opens or closes one.

props.name: headingLevel
props.description: The heading level of each group's title, so it fits the page's outline.

props.name: collapsed
props.description: Narrow screens: one disclosure naming the current page, with the list inside it.

props.name: open
props.description: Whether the collapsed disclosure is open; read only when `collapsed`.

props.name: onOpenChange
props.description: Called when the person opens or closes the collapsed disclosure.

props.name: fallbackLabel
props.description: The disclosure's name when no item is current.

props.name: onNavigate
props.description: Called with an item's `id` when the person follows it, for apps that route on the client. The link still follows its `href`.

props.name: size
props.description: `m` (default) the 44 px targets under heading titles; `s` a dense app frame's navigation (LR41): 36 px rows (above the WCAG 2.2 AA 24 px minimum), a step smaller words and small muted group titles. Pair it with AppLayout `size="s"`.

props.name: label
props.description: The page's name, as it reads in the list.

props.name: href
props.description: Where it goes: a URL or an in-app route.

props.name: id
props.description: Stable identity; listed in `expanded` while the family is open.

props.name: title
props.description: The family's name, on the button that opens and closes it.

props.name: title
props.description: The group's name, shown as a heading above its entries; also names its list for assistive technology.
